description: Plan AI product videos for one market and platform, Higgsfield-style: preset formats (hero orbit, texture macro, unboxing POV, 3-step routine, local lifestyle, AI presenter) with camera moves, a shot list, keyframe and image-to-video prompts, ready request bodies for treg.to video models (draft Seedance 1 Lite, standard Hailuo 2.3, premium Veo 3.1 Fast; HeyGen avatar for presenters), hook variants for A/B tests, the platform spec (aspect, length, safe zone), voice-over language, music, AI-label and claims rules, and the estimated cost. Starts from the real packshot so the pack never changes. It reads the product's rules in that market first: sale gates to clear before spending on ads (sale_gate, e.g. a US sunscreen is an OTC drug), the rules that bind ads there (ad_rules, with official sources) and wording in the product name, description, company record or your copy that does not fit them (claims_check: what to say instead), plus local_words for captions and hashtags; signed in, it uses the company's brand, valid certifications, origin and proof points (company). read_market_first lists the market signals to read before writing hooks (this week's rising hashtags and top videos on that platform in that country, competitors' long-running ads, the best sellers' 1–3★ reviews), and each hook angle says which signal sets its first 2 seconds (from_signal). Signed in, each read_market_first step carries last_read when the company already saved that read (company_context kind=signal, with its age and whether it is stale), and each hook angle carries the company's own result there (your_views, your_hold_rate past 2 seconds; all of them in hook_tests, from company_context kind=result). Free, read-only — generation runs on the user's treg token.

copy.description: Optional: your own ad copy, captions, voice-over script or listing text for this market; claims_check flags wording that does not fit the market's rules and says what to use instead.

country.description: Target country as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 (e.g. 'US', 'JP') or an English/Korean name.

description.description: Optional: the product as the user describes it, any language (e.g. '비건 선크림 SPF50', '할랄 인증 저가 립스틱', 'premium anti-aging ampoule already on Amazon US'). Used to detect product traits that change the rules within one HS code (see traits) and the concepts, price tier, certifications and markets already selling that change which market fits (product_profile, entry_paths).

has_packshot.description: Whether a real product photo exists (default true). Without one the plan asks for it first.

item.description: Product as an HS4 code (e.g. '3304') or a name in English or Korean (e.g. 'sunscreen', '라면'). Names cover TradeGraph's 35 items; any other product works as a 4-digit HS code (e.g. '1905' biscuits, '2005' kimchi, '3305' shampoo) with live UN Comtrade imports. Optional; sets the product group for scenes and claims rules.

platform.description: Where the video runs; auto = the market's first creator platform.

preset.description: Video format; auto = three presets that suit the product group.

product.description: The product in plain English as it looks, e.g. 'vegan sunscreen SPF50, 50 ml white tube with green cap'. Used in every prompt.

tier.description: Model tier: draft (cheap 480p tests), standard (Hailuo 2.3 768P), premium (Veo 3.1 Fast 1080p).

traits.description: Optional: product traits, comma-separated, that change the rules within one HS code: sunscreen, whitening (also arbutin, kojic acid), vitamin_a (retinol), gel_nail (UV/LED gel, semi-cured strips), contact_lens (HS 9001: contact lenses, colour lenses), hair_dye, hair_loss, acne, antiperspirant, dandruff, fluoride (toothpaste), human_derived (human stem cell culture media, human placenta, cord blood: a ban in the EU, UK, China and ASEAN), stem_cell (stem cell culture media whose source is not named: check it), exosome, radio (Bluetooth, Wi-Fi, cellular), battery, meat, dairy, egg, aerosol, flammable, industrial or household (for HS codes that hold both, such as 8414 fans, compressors and vacuum pumps: picks machinery rules, trade fairs and buyer searches, or household-appliance ones). Also detected from item, product and description; the answer lists them in product_traits.

variants.description: Hook variants per preset (A/B test the first 2 seconds).

name: video_studio
title: Short-form video ads for a market (Higgsfield-style presets)
